FASTER, HIGHER, SMARTER

We offer world-class private air charter services to individuals, families, and businesses looking for a safe, easy, and cost-effective way to reach their next destination.

​

No wonder why our customers think that flying with us is the smart way to fly private.

It's about the journey

The world at your fingertips
============================

Whether you fly on one of our Phenom 100's from southern California to Las Vegas, take a business trip upstate, or want to take the entire family overseas, we have an available option for you.

Book your next trip

### Your safety, our priority

At Onward Jets safety is our top priority, our airplanes are thoroughly inspected by our crews before and after every flight, and maintained by a factory-approved service center. We rely on technology to monitor and stay ahead of bad weather to make your trip safe and comfortable.

We provide ongoing training for our pilots at the top-rated training facilities in the country.

​

Onward Jets is a proud Argus Gold rated charter operator which means we have achieved the highest level of quality in aviation as we have adhered to the highest international standards in the industry.
